name: Logic City - Pattern & Cipher Arena
description: Simulation and reasoning engine for logical patterns, substitution ciphers, direction grids, ranking logic, and visual deduction across the TezMindz 5-stage mastery model.
author: TezMindz Olympiad Team

stages.name: Concept Discovery
stages.focus: Manipulate sequence gears and substitution ciphers, observe live transformation

stages.name: Guided Simulation
stages.focus: Goal-driven logical deduction with 4-tier progressive hints

stages.name: Rule Discovery
stages.focus: Formulate the pattern/cipher transition rule in plain language

stages.name: Controlled Practice
stages.focus: Dynamic variations across numbers, letters, shapes, and rotational steps

stages.name: Anti-Memorisation Assessment
stages.focus: Novel context puzzle solved through pure reasoning without visual manipulators

sampleData.prompt: Find the missing symbol in the Logic City conveyor sequence according to the transformation rule.
sampleData.subPrompt: Inspect the alternating jump of numbers and letter symbols.

cipherRules.target: +3 positions in alphabet (A -> D -> G -> J -> M -> P)

progressiveHints: Level 1 (Attention): Separate each term into its letter part and its number part.
Level 2 (Reasoning): Letters advance by +3: A(+3)=D, D(+3)=G, G(+3)=J. What is J + 3?
Level 3 (Demonstration): Numbers also advance by +3: 2, 5, 8, 11, 11 + 3 = 14. For letters: J is 10th letter, 10 + 3 = 13th letter which is M.
Level 4 (Full Solution): The combination is M + 14 = M14. Verify next term: M(+3)=P, 14(+3)=17 (P17). Correct answer is M14.

ruleDiscovery.statementPrompt: Complete the rule governing this alternating sequence:
ruleOptions: Both the letter (alphabetical index) and number increase by +3 at each step
The letter stays the same while the number doubles
Only the vowel positions are counted
ruleDiscovery.correctRule: Both the letter (alphabetical index) and number increase by +3 at each step

sampleData.explanation: Letters increase by 3 alphabetical steps: A -> D -> G -> J -> M. Numbers increase by +3: 2 -> 5 -> 8 -> 11 -> 14. Result is M14.
